Code snippet (Python) to programmatically generate template messages
Note: This script fills a small template and inserts the disclosure line.

```python
def make_message(name, purpose, body_lines):
    disclosure = "I drafted this with the help of an AI assistant so I could say it clearly."
    header = f"{name} — {purpose}"
    body = "\n".join(body_lines)
    return f"{header}\n{body}\n{disclosure}"

# Examples
msg1 = make_message("Alex", "catching up and arranging coffee",
                    ["Hey Alex — hope you’re doing well!",
                     "It’s been a while. Would you like to grab coffee next week?"])
msg2 = make_message("Jamie", "congratulating on a promotion",
                    ["Congrats on the promotion! So proud of you.",
                     "Let’s celebrate soon."])

print(msg1)
print("---")
print(msg2)
```
